Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
Urinalysis shows significant bacteriuria (>100,000 CFU/mL E. coli), positive nitrites, leukocyte esterase, elevated leukocytes, and presence of blood, indicating a urinary tract infection. Glucosuria is present without ketones, suggesting possible hyperglycemia. Low specific gravity may indicate dilute urine. Recommend clinical correlation for UTI symptoms and evaluation for diabetes mellitus.
